summary: Build an app with a Learning section where only Admin and Admin-assigned Teacher Badge users can add/upload courses; includes a visible Teacher Badge icon on teacher profiles.
architectural_notes: Introduce role/permission checks for Learning section course creation (Admin or TeacherBadge=true).
Admin-only UI/actions to grant/revoke Teacher Badge for a user.
Teacher Badge visual spec: small badge styled as a red tick containing a mini book icon, clearly indicating teacher status.

existing_features.title: Implement the Teacher Badge UI as a small red tick badge containing a mini book icon, and render it anywhere the app currently shows a verified avatar overlay (so users can instantly recognize teachers).
Add Admin controls in the existing Admin user moderation UI to grant and revoke Teacher Badge for a selected user, with clear English labels and success/error toasts.
Provide a course/lesson creation entry point in the Learning section UI for authorized creators (Admin and Teacher Badge holders only); hide or disable creation UI for all other users.

new_feature_requests.summary: Add Teacher Badge system: Admin can grant/revoke badge; only Admin and badge holders can add/upload courses in the Learning section; show a Teacher Badge icon (red tick with mini book) on badged users.
Add a Teacher Badge flag to user profiles that can be granted/revoked only by Admin, and expose it in public profile APIs so the frontend can render a Teacher Badge indicator for any user who has it.
Allow only Admin users and Teacher Badge holders to create/add Learning content (courses/lessons); all other users must be blocked from creating lessons/courses.
